title: 第3章 得知真相的千仞雪，与灵眸少年的初见
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

千仞雪猛地转身，手中天使圣剑瞬间被召唤而出，紧接着她持剑指向前方，眼神锐利，用强悍的精神力扫视四周，结果并无任何发现。

“奇怪？难道是错觉？”

千仞雪疑惑地缓缓放下手中的天使圣剑，结果下一秒——

“唔——”

她的大脑瞬间发昏，然后她就好像进入了一个非常玄妙的状态。

灵魂出现在一个混沌的空间，四周什么都没有，可在她还没有什么动作之际，混沌的最深处出现一道微弱的亮光。

明明很微弱，也看不清它的具体形态，可在千仞雪脑海中她却清晰地‘看’到了它。

“千仞雪，斗罗星要完了！我希望你能够救救斗罗星！救救我……”

“什么意思？你是谁？”

面对千仞雪的质疑，那道声音并没有过多解释，反而是将一切全都敞开来，给千仞雪看。

千仞雪眼前飞快划过很多画面，有万年前武魂殿时代的，有万年后如今这个时代的，更有未来的。

一切的一切，如同过眼云烟划过的很快，却又好像每一幕都印在千仞雪的脑海中。

千仞雪懂了，她什么都明白了！

武魂殿在成立武魂帝国后，就被以正义自称的海神唐三，带着他的六个小伙伴给毁了。

而她也因为神格破碎，世间再无天使神。比比东——她所不愿意承认的母亲，在成就罗刹神后，为了保护她，死于唐三的修罗剑之下。

这也便罢了，跟唐三之后的种种所作所为相比，毁灭武魂帝国算什么，他简直就是趴在斗罗星身上的巨大吸血虫。

他是飞升成神了，但却在斗罗大陆留下一堆烂摊子。身为神王本不该插手人间事，可他倒好，为了将整个斗罗星彻底变成自己的一言堂。

不但安排父母一个替代斗罗星原本意志成为什么斗罗位面之主，一个则是化身生命之树，进一步压榨斗罗位面最后的力量。

而他自己，靠着打压异己，收位面之子为狗，更是对斗罗危机视而不见，规划万年大计。

最终在至今的两万年后，终于将斗罗星的全部气运尽收囊中，至此斗罗的一切彻底成为了他唐三的，沦为一潭死水。

这是不对的，斗罗星的气运和一切属于所有斗罗星生灵，不该尽数归于一人之手。

那会是灾难，当一个位面所有的一切，全赖于一人的喜怒哀乐，那对普通生灵来说算什么？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qian Renxue turned around suddenly, and the angel holy sword in her hand was instantly summoned. Then she pointed the sword forward with sharp eyes and scanned the surroundings with strong mental power, but found nothing.

"Strange? Is it an illusion?"

Qian Renxue slowly put down the angel holy sword in her hand in confusion, but the next second——

"Uh-"

Her brain was dizzy for a moment, and then she seemed to have entered a very mysterious state.

The soul appeared in a chaotic space with nothing around it, but before she made any move, a faint light appeared in the deepest part of the chaos.

It was obviously very faint and its specific form could not be seen clearly, but in Qian Renxue's mind she could clearly 'see' it.

"Qian Renxue, Douluo Star is doomed! I hope you can save Douluo Star! Save me..."

"What do you mean? Who are you?"

Faced with Qian Renxue's doubts, the voice did not explain too much. Instead, it opened everything up for Qian Renxue to see.

Many pictures flashed across Qian Renxue's eyes, including those from the Wuhun Palace era ten thousand years ago, the present era ten thousand years later, and even the future.

Everything passed by quickly like a fleeting cloud, but it seemed as if every scene was imprinted in Qian Renxue's mind.

Qian Renxue understands, she understands everything!

After the establishment of the Wuhun Empire, the Wuhun Palace was destroyed by Tang San, the Poseidon who claimed to be just, and his six friends.

And because her divinity was broken, there was no longer an angel or god in the world.Bibi Dong, the mother she was unwilling to admit, died under Tang San's Shura Sword in order to protect her after becoming a Rakshasa God.

That's all. Compared with everything Tang San did after that, destroying the Spirit Empire was nothing. He was simply a giant blood-sucking insect lying on Douluo Star.

He ascended to become a god, but he left a mess in Douluo Continent.As a god king, he shouldn't interfere in human affairs, but it's better for him, in order to completely turn the entire Douluo Star into his own.

Not only did he arrange for one of his parents to replace Douluo Xing's original intention to become the master of the Douluo plane, but the other was to transform into the Tree of Life, further squeezing the last power of the Douluo plane.

And he himself relied on suppressing dissenters and accepting the children of the plane as dogs. He turned a blind eye to the Douluo crisis and planned a ten-year plan.

In the end, twenty thousand years later, all the Douluo Star's destiny was finally captured. At this point, everything about Douluo became Tang San's and became a pool of stagnant water.

This is wrong. The fate and everything of Douluo Star belongs to all Douluo Star creatures and should not be put into the hands of one person.

That would be a disaster. When everything in a plane depends on one person's joy, anger, sorrow, and joy, what does that mean to ordinary living beings?
